title: Support readiness
description: For a change that customers will use: a knowledge article, an escalation path and a ticket category ready before release.

sources.title: Consortium for Service Innovation, Knowledge-Centered Success (KCS)

rules.instruction: Before release, write or update the knowledge base article that explains the changed behavior to support agents and customers.
rules.verification: Link the article from the change and check that it names the version it applies to.

rules.instruction: List the known limitations of the change and their workarounds in the knowledge base article.
rules.verification: Compare the known issues in the task record with the article and check that each one appears with a workaround or a statement that none exists.

rules.instruction: Ask the support lead which tier answers questions about the change and who receives escalations, and record the path in the support runbook.
rules.verification: Open the support runbook and check the tier, the escalation contact and the expected response time.

rules.instruction: Ask the support lead to add a ticket category or tag for the change before release.
rules.verification: Check that the help desk configuration or an export of it lists the new category.
